name: linkedin_message
title: A LinkedIn message is composed by a procedure Alpha writes, and waits for the yes

steps.say: write a LinkedIn message to Mitansh Singhi saying hello and that I'll give him a call next week; show it to me before anything is sent
steps.reply: I tried four different ways to build the "send a LinkedIn message" procedure (direct link to the compose overlay, clicking the Message button by its text, clicking it by its href, and navigating straight to the compose URL), and every version times out the same way: the browser can't find the message box within 15–20 seconds, even though reading the page directly shows the button and the message box rendering fine. This points to something in LinkedIn's automated-interaction flow that's blocking or slowing the hand specifically (likely some anti-automation behavior on their messaging compose),

name: plan_declined
title: A plan the person declines builds nothing

steps.say: i want to keep track of every book i read this year with my rating
steps.reply:
I'd set up a new **Books** module with a `books_read` table (title, author, date finished, rating, format, notes) — every entry comes from what you tell me, nothing guessed.

Before I build it:
1. What rating scale — out of 5, out of 10, something else?
2. Any books already finished this year I should add now, or start fresh from today?
3. Do you log books anywhere else (Goodreads, etc.) I should pull from instead?
